provenance.aggregation: Mean of normalized X over original WNN res-0.3 members; float32 cached profile
provenance.uncertainty: Per-bin sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not uncertainty of a cluster estimate
provenance.zero_policy: No pseudocount; log2 ratio undefined if either level is zero
provenance.scope: Descriptive recomputation; no segmentation, CN, SRD, bootstrap or merge decisions
